facts.text: I use one egg as a binder in my baked meatball recipe.
I dice half an onion and save the leftovers to use in my scrambled eggs and to stir fries later this week.
I use one third cup of diced onion in the meatballs.
I use a quarter cup of finely chopped fresh parsley in the meatballs.
I use three garlic cloves in the meatballs.
I preheat my oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit for baked meatballs.
I use one and a half pounds of ground meat for the meatballs.
I like a combination of ground beef and ground pork for the meatballs.
I use 1 pound of ground beef and half a pound of ground pork in the meatballs.
I use one tablespoon of Italian seasoning in the meatballs.
I use one teaspoon of kosher salt in the meatballs.
I use half a teaspoon of ground black pepper in the meatballs.
I use a quarter cup of almond flour in the meatballs.
I use a quarter cup of shredded Parmesan cheese in the meatballs.
I use a medium cookie scoop to portion the meat mixture into meatballs.
I bake the meatballs for about 20 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through.
I cook my meatballs for 18 minutes and then broil them for the last two minutes.
I make a homemade marinara sauce with five simple ingredients.
I use one small onion for my marinara sauce.
I use about one tablespoon of chopped basil in the marinara sauce.
I use about one tablespoon of fresh thyme in the marinara sauce.
I use four garlic cloves in the marinara sauce.
I add one tablespoon of olive oil to a pot over medium-high heat to saute the onion.
I saute the onion for three to four minutes until translucent in the marinara sauce.
I saute the minced garlic for about 30 seconds in the marinara sauce.
I use one 28 ounce can of crushed tomatoes in the marinara sauce.
I add a quarter teaspoon of kosher salt to the marinara sauce.
I simmer the marinara sauce for 20 to 25 minutes.
I stir in chopped fresh basil at the very end of simmering the marinara sauce.
I transfer the marinara sauce to my large braiser pan when I plan to use it right away.
I enjoy the meatballs by plopping them into the marinara pan, rolling them around, and simmering on low to keep them warmed through.
I sprinkle fresh parsley before serving for a pop of green.
I like to eat these meatballs over spiralized zucchini noodles.
I sometimes serve the meatballs as an appetizer by sticking a toothpick in each one.
I aim for exactly 30 meatballs so they fit perfectly on one sheet pan.
I believe the meatballs are gluten free and low carb.
